description: Fetch fresh analytics for a published post from the provider and store a new snapshot, then return it. Supported providers: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, X, Pinterest, Snapchat (others return an unsupported snapshot). Call this before get_analytics when you need current numbers rather than the last stored snapshot.

postId.description: The published post id to refresh.

name: refresh_analytics
title: Refresh analytics
